name: Original Speed
description:
You move so fast you simply aren't where you were.  Faster and further than any lesser vampire.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 40 ml

name: Feed
description:
Catch someone, sink your fangs in and drink.  Humans and animals feed you; other vampires just bleed.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 0 ml

name: Rip Out the Heart
description:
Your signature.  Drive your hand through their chest and pull out their heart.  Very few things walk away from that.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 120 ml
message: You plunge your hand into their chest.

name: Healing Blood
description:
Bite your wrist and let someone drink.  An Original's blood heals nearly anything.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml
message: Dark blood wells up from your wrist.

name: Mikaelson Temper
description:
Stop holding back.  For a few minutes you are stronger and faster still, and pain means nothing.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 100 ml

name: Original Apex Stride (100 km/h)
description:
Engage thousand-year-old apex Original velocity (~100 km/h) burning 5 mL blood every 10 turns. Slashes movement costs to ~3 moves per tile and grants absolute flawless dodge against all incoming attacks. Cast again to toggle off.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 5 mL upfront, then 5 mL / 10 turns
<color_light_green>Speed:</color> ~100 km/h (-90% move cost)
<color_light_blue>Defense:</color> Flawless Apex Dodge (+80 dodge mod, +50 dodge skill)

name: Hybrid Breach Kick
description:
Unleash a savage, feral kick backed by the terrifying hybrid strength of an Original vampire and werewolf—smashing through 200 points of reinforced walls, doors, and barriers in an explosive shockwave, while hurling any creature on that tile flying across the room!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Breach Kick Shockwave
description: Caster sound, message, and shockwave of Klaus's hybrid breach kick.

name: Breach Kick Launch
description: Knockback and shockwave for creatures struck by Klaus's hybrid breach kick.

name: Savage Body Hurl
description:
Grab an adjacent creature with monstrous hybrid werewolf strength and violently heave its entire mass through the air up to 10 tiles away in any direction. Colliding with walls detonates barriers and obliterates skeletons; skipping violently across open ground breaks bones in a chorus of snapping fractures.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml

name: Apex Blitz & Neck Snap
description:
Pounce across the room with apex hybrid speed (up to 14 tiles away), seize their skull with an iron grip, and wrench their cervical spine sideways with a ferocious, bone-shattering snap!

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_cyan>Cooldown:</color> 3 seconds

name: Hybrid Vortex Sweep
description:
Seize an adjacent foe with monstrous hybrid power and swing them in a furious, blood-splattered vortex around your body, violently smashing every enemy within reach before launching the pulverized carcass away.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Centrifugal Vortex Sweep
description: Centrifugal impact of Hybrid Vortex Sweep hitting surrounding enemies.

name: Supersonic Kinetic Throw
description:
Hurl an improvised weapon or item from your inventory with monstrous hybrid velocity up to 25 tiles away. Propelled past Mach 3 by werewolf-tier acceleration, the projectile breaks the sound barrier with an explosive thunderclap, punch-through penetrating whatever it hits.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml
<color_yellow>Eligible Projectiles:</color> Coins, loose ammunition, pebbles, nails, spikes, ball bearings, glass bottles/shards, bones, severed heads/arms/legs, pens, cutlery, sports balls, wooden stakes, rebar, tools, and blades.

name: Savage Limb Tear & Spine-Breaker
description:
Seize an adjacent vulnerable foe and savagely dismember them with hybrid claws and raw brute force: tear off their right arm, left arm, right leg, or left leg, or crush their lower spine into powder beneath a devastating stomp.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 25 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Target must be injured, stunned, terrified, or knocked down. Bare hands required.

name: Apex Hybrid Senses & Blood Radar
description:
Combine the acute hearing and scent of an apex werewolf with the ancient senses of an Original vampire. Detects every heartbeat, bleeding wound, and moving creature within 45 tiles through solid walls and pitch darkness for 15 minutes.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 10 ml

name: Plunge White Oak Stake
description: Attempt to drive the White Oak Stake through an adjacent Original's heart.  The target must be knocked down, stunned, or asleep before you can target their heart.  Even pinned or sleeping, an Original can deflect the strike (15-20% success rate).

name: Targeted Apex Leap
description:
Channel the ungodly kinetic force of a thousand-year-old Original into your legs, launching your body in a massive preternatural leap up to 16 tiles away. Effortlessly vaults over high fences, barricades, and ascends directly onto multi-story building rooftops (target upper levels using upstairs and downstairs keys). Your indestructible skeletal structure absorbs 100% of the landing impact with a thunderous concussive boom.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 15 ml

name: Apex Leap Sound & Impact
description: Sound and concussion of Apex Leap landing.

name: Original Sanguine Surge
description:
Call upon a thousand years of concentrated progenitor vitae to forcefully mend shattered bones and seal severed flesh mid-combat. Instantly sets crippled limbs to minimum functioning (50 HP), wipes all hemorrhaging, and floods your vitals with regenerative force.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 250 ml
<color_yellow>Cooldown:</color> 20 seconds

name: Expel Wood Splinters
description: Focus your immortal anatomy to purge foreign wooden splinters lodged in your flesh. Opens an action menu allowing you to manually pluck fragments, surge pressurized vitae to blow them out, or cauterize the wound.

name: Original Terror Pulse
description: Radiates the overwhelming aura of a thousand-year-old Original progenitor across a 15-tile radius, breaking the morale of mortals and lesser vampires with paralyzing dread.

name: Original Blood Sharing & Siring
description:
Bite open your wrist and offer your thousand-year-old Original blood to an adjacent human, survivor in transition, or sired vampire:
• Mortal NPC: Bestows rapid cellular regeneration and imbues them with Original Vampire Blood in System. If they die within 24 hours, they awaken In Transition.
• In Transition: Feed them blood to complete their transformation into an immortal Vampire Thrall.
• Vampire: Bestow a forged Daylight Ring so they never burn in the sun.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml

name: Forge Lapis Daylight Ring (Occult Ritual)
description:
Perform an ancient occult ritual to bind a permanent solar ward into a signet ring, silver ring, gold ring, or platinum ring from your inventory. Consumes 1,200 Mana and 300 mL of blood to create an Original Lapis Daylight Ring.

<color_cyan>Mana Cost:</color> 1,200 Mana
<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 300 mL
<color_yellow>Component:</color> Any signet, silver, gold, copper, platinum, or diamond ring.

name: Savage Decapitation
description:
Seize their skull and violently rip their head clean off their shoulders with monstrous hybrid strength. Massive damage to anything with a head, and anything left weak enough is decapitated outright in a torrent of blood.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 200 ml
<color_yellow>Requirement:</color> Empty hands.

name: Original Compulsion
description:
Lock eyes with your victim and impose your unbreakable alpha will. A compelled human or vampire fights by your side for five minutes. As an Original you can compel vampires as easily as mortals.

<color_light_red>Blood Cost:</color> 150 ml
message: "Look into my eyes. You belong to me now." Their eyes glaze over.
